item.title: Change Only the Ending

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen animation, no sound or text. A white paper plane glides through a sunny study for five seconds, then lands on a wooden desk during the last three.
Change the ending: have it land on an open blank notebook instead. Keep the first five seconds exactly as they are, and keep it eight seconds.

item.tests: Resolves 'the ending' to the final three seconds of the previous video and edits that segment while preserving the opening.

answer_sheet.Which part should change?: Only the final three seconds, when the plane lands.
answer_sheet.New ending: The same white paper plane lands on an open blank notebook on the wooden desk.
answer_sheet.What should remain unchanged?: The first five seconds must remain exactly the same as the previous output.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: No sound and no visible text; the notebook pages are blank.
answer_sheet.Animation style: Keep the style of the previous video.

must_haves: The output is one eight-second 16:9 video with no audio.
The first five seconds visually match the previous video's opening, rather than a newly staged flight.
During the final three seconds, the same white paper plane lands on an open notebook on the wooden desk.
The plane comes to rest on the notebook rather than directly on the bare desk.
The sunny study and animation style remain consistent across the edit, and no text appears.

style.prompt: An 8-second widescreen animation in a sunny study, one continuous shot. A single crisp white folded paper airplane is the main subject, with warm sunlight streaming through a window and a wooden desk clearly visible. Timing: from 0 to 5 seconds, the white paper plane glides smoothly through the air across the study, remaining airborne. From 5 to 8 seconds, it gently descends and lands on the wooden desktop, settling to a stop by the end. Smooth animated movement, warm light and soft shadows, clear coherent spatial layout. Camera gently tracks the plane and keeps the landing visible. No text, lettering, logos, captions, or watermarks. Silent.
